newsitem.title: USA: TRC Cos sees market weaknesses in Q3.
newsitem.headline: TRC Cos sees market weaknesses in Q3.

text.p: TRC Cos Inc said on Wednesday it foresaw weakness in its federal and commercial markets in the third quarter of 1997.

The environmental services company said in a statement that "business trends are improving for the private sector, but that the federal government and commercial hazardous waste markets will continue to be weak in the third quarter due to continued regulatory uncertainty and budget reductions.

"Management's goals for the remainder of fiscal 1997 are to maximize the company's operating performance through growth in revenue, increase operating margins and net income, repay additional long-term debt and increase the return on equity."
The company said it had net income of $119,708, or $0.02 per share for the second quarter ended December 31, compared with net income of $539,070 or $0.08 per share in the same period last year.
"During the quarter, the company was affected by the continued weakness in the environmental market, especially as it relates to hazardous waste services," the statement said.
